title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Manager to lead our digital marketing and social media initiatives and drive brand growth, customer engagement, and business results.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Develop and execute digital marketing \& social media strategies
* Manage campaigns across Google, Meta, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube and other platforms
* Lead SEO, SEM, paid advertising, content marketing \& social media campaigns
* Manage and monitor the company website
* Track campaign performance, analytics, ROI and prepare reports
* Lead internal digital marketing teams and coordinate with external agencies
* Drive brand awareness, customer engagement, leads and business growth
* Stay updated with the latest digital trends, tools and technologies



 Requirements
 


* 20\+ years of relevant experience in Digital Marketing \& Social Media Marketing
* Preferably experienced in established corporate companies
* Proven track record of successful digital campaigns and brand growth
* Strong expertise in SEO, SEM, Paid Ads, Social Media \& Digital Strategy
* Excellent leadership, communication, analytical and strategic skills
* Degree in Marketing, Business Administration or a related field preferred
